functions: Tax on taxable income at the general rates, 2024-25 to 2026-27, before the Medicare levy and offsets

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  IncomeTaxλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Tax on taxable income at the general rates for a full-year resident or foreign resident individual, 2024-25 to 2026-27, before the Medicare levy and offsets*/
/*  SOURCE:         Income Tax Rates Act 1986, compilation 66 (1 July 2026), read 22 November 2026:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A03348/2026-07-01/2026-07-01/text/original/epub/OEBPS/document_1/document_1.html
                    s 3(1): the tax-free threshold is $18,200. Schedule 7 Part I clause 1(b), resident
                    taxpayers: 2024-25 and 2025-26, 16% above the threshold to $45,000; 2026-27, 15%; then
                    30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000 and 45% above. Part II clause 1(b), non-resident
                    taxpayers from 2024-25: the second resident personal tax rate (30%) to $135,000, the
                    third (37%) to $190,000 and 45% above.
                    ATO, 'Tax rates - Australian residents', last updated 13 August 2026, and 'Tax rates -
                    foreign resident', last updated 19 November 2026, read 22 November 2026, give the same
                    tables for 2024-25 to 2026-27 and list no later year:
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-rates-australian-residents
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-rates-foreign-residents
                    Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 (No. 49, 2026), Schedule 1 item 119-1,
                    read 22 November 2026: extra income tax on capital gains (ITAA 1997 Division 119) applies
                    to CGT events from 1 July 2027, so 2027-28 is refused:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2026A00049/asmade/text
*/
IncomeTaxλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [TaxableIncome],
    [IncomeYear],
    [Resident],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →IncomeTaxλ(TaxableIncome, IncomeYear, [Resident])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Tax on taxable income at the general rates, before the Medicare levy and offsets.¶NOTES!         →Tax on taxable income at the general rates of the Income Tax Rates Act¶               →1986, Schedule 7, for an individual who was a resident (Part I) or a¶               →foreign resident (Part II) for the whole income year: the ATO's 'tax on¶               →this income'. For 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 only; 2027-28 is refused, as¶               →the ATO has not published its rates and extra tax on capital gains begins¶               →then. The result is not rounded. Arithmetic only: it leaves out the¶               →Medicare levy and surcharge, tax offsets, the pro-rated tax-free threshold¶               →of a part-year resident, working holiday makers' rates, minors' unearned¶               →income, superannuation and employment termination remainders and special¶               →income components such as averaging.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit/blob/main/docs/australian-modelling.md¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →22 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "TaxableIncome  →(Required) One or more taxable incomes, each 0 or more. A blank stays blank.¶" &
                            "IncomeYear     →(Required) The year the income year ends: 2025, 2026 or 2027 for 2024-25 to 2026-27.¶" &
                            "Resident       →(Optional: Default = TRUE) TRUE or 1 for a resident, FALSE or 0 for a foreign resident, for the whole year.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.IncomeTaxλ({31130;39000}, 2026)¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→2068.8¶" &
                            "→3328",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR( ISOMITTED( TaxableIncome), ISOMITTED( IncomeYear)),
        ValidYear?,     IFERROR( AND( ROWS( IncomeYear) = 1, COLUMNS( IncomeYear) = 1, ISNUMBER( XMATCH( IncomeYear, {2025, 2026, 2027}, 0))), FALSE),
        YearMessage,    "IncomeYear must be 2025, 2026 or 2027, the year the income year ends; 2027-28 and later are not supported.",
    //  A blank Resident cell is not an omitted argument, so test for both
        Home,           IF( ISOMITTED( Resident), TRUE, IF( TRIM( Resident & "") = "", TRUE, Resident)),
        ValidResident?, IFERROR( AND( ROWS( Home) = 1, COLUMNS( Home) = 1, OR( ISLOGICAL( Home), AND( ISNUMBER( Home), OR( Home = 0, Home = 1)))), FALSE),
        ResidentMessage, "Resident must be TRUE or 1 for a resident, FALSE or 0 for a foreign resident.",
    //  A blank is nil and stays blank; an error passes so it shows
        ValidIncome?,   AND( IF( ISERROR( TaxableIncome), TRUE, IF( ISNUMBER( TaxableIncome), ( TaxableIncome >= 0) * ( TaxableIncome < 1E13), TRIM( TaxableIncome & "") = ""))),
        IncomeMessage,  "IncomeTaxλ needs each taxable income to be a number from 0 to under 10,000,000,000,000, or blank.",
    //  Procedure - each slice of income at its rate in whole percent, divided by 100 at
    //  the end so whole dollars give exact cents
        Low,            IF( IncomeYear = 2027, 15, 16),
        Slice,          LAMBDA( Income, From, To, MAX( 0, MIN( Income, To) - From)),
        Result,         MAP( TaxableIncome, LAMBDA( Income,
                            IF( TRIM( Income & "") = "", "",
                                ( IF( Home,
                                    Slice( Income, 18200, 45000) * Low + Slice( Income, 45000, 135000) * 30,
                                    Slice( Income, 0, 135000) * 30) +
                                  Slice( Income, 135000, 190000) * 37 + MAX( 0, Income - 190000) * 45) / 100)
                        )),
    //  Return Result, Help, or the message
        Return,         IF( Help?, 2, IF( NOT( ValidYear?), 3, IF( NOT( ValidResident?), 4, IF( NOT( ValidIncome?), 5, 1)))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, YearMessage, ResidentMessage, IncomeMessage)
    )
);

Financial: "NetCapitalGainλ    →Net capital gain after capital losses and the CGT discount, for 2025-26 or 2026-27¶"
